parameters.name: CompositeExpression
parameters.description:
The alert conditions for multiple metrics.

> Single-metric and multi-metric alert conditions are mutually exclusive and cannot be set at the same time.

parameters.name: ContactGroups
parameters.description:
The alert contact group. Alert notifications are sent to the alert contacts in the alert contact group.

> An alert contact group is a group of alert contacts that can contain one or more alert contacts. For more information about how to create alert contacts and alert contact groups, see [PutContact](~~114923~~) and [PutContactGroup](~~114929~~).

parameters.name: EffectiveInterval
parameters.description: The effective period of the alert rule.

parameters.name: EmailSubject
parameters.description: The subject of the alert email.

parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.ComparisonOperator
parameters.description:
The comparison operator for the Critical level. Valid values:

- GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold: greater than or equal to the threshold.
- GreaterThanThreshold: greater than the threshold.
- LessThanOrEqualToThreshold: less than or equal to the threshold.
- LessThanThreshold: less than the threshold.
- NotEqualToThreshold: not equal to the threshold.
- EqualToThreshold: equal to the threshold.
- GreaterThanYesterday: greater than the value at the same time yesterday.
- LessThanYesterday: less than the value at the same time yesterday.
- GreaterThanLastWeek: greater than the value at the same time last week.
- LessThanLastWeek: less than the value at the same time last week.
- GreaterThanLastPeriod: greater than the value in the last period.
- LessThanLastPeriod: less than the value in the last period.

> At least one of the alert levels Critical, Warn, or Info must be set. The parameters Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times must be set together for the specified alert level.

parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.Statistics
parameters.description:
The statistical method for the Critical level.

The value of this parameter is determined by the `Statistics` column corresponding to the `MetricName` of the specified Alibaba Cloud service, such as Maximum, Minimum, and Average. For more information about how to obtain the value of this parameter, see [Alibaba Cloud service monitoring metrics](~~163515~~).

> At least one of the alert levels Critical (critical), Warn (warning), or Info (information) must be settings. The parameters Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times must be set together for the specified alert level.

parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.Threshold
parameters.description:
The threshold for the Critical level.


> At least one of the alert levels Critical, Warn, or Info must be set. The parameters Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times must be set together for the specified alert level.

parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.Times
parameters.description:
The retry count for the Critical level.

> At least one of the alert levels Critical, Warn, or Info must be set. The parameters Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times must be set together for the specified alert level.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The trigger period of the alert rule. Unit: seconds.

> For more information about how to query the statistical period of a metric, see [Alibaba Cloud service monitoring metrics](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description:
When the metric meets the alert condition and an alert is triggered, the labels are written to the metric and displayed in the alert notification.

> This feature is the same as the Label feature in Prometheus alerting.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The label value.

> The label value supports template parameters. Template parameters are replaced with actual label values.

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description:
The name of the metric. For more information about how to query metric names, see [Alibaba Cloud service monitoring metrics](~~163515~~).

> If you create a Prometheus alert rule for Hybrid Cloud Monitoring, this parameter specifies the name of the metric repository. For more information about how to obtain the metric repository name, see [DescribeHybridMonitorNamespaceList](~~428880~~).

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service. For more information about how to query the namespace of an Alibaba Cloud service, see [Alibaba Cloud service monitoring metrics](~~163515~~).

> If you create a Prometheus alert rule for Hybrid Cloud Monitoring, set this parameter to `acs_prometheus`.

parameters.name: NoDataPolicy
parameters.description:
The processing method when no monitoring data is found. Valid values:

- KEEP\_LAST\_STATE (default): No action is performed.
- INSUFFICIENT\_DATA: An alert whose content is "Insufficient Data" is triggered.
- OK: The status is considered normal.

parameters.name: NoEffectiveInterval
parameters.description: The time range during which the alert rule is ineffective.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The statistical period of the metric. Unit: seconds. The default value is the original reporting period of the metric.

> For more information about how to query the statistical period of a metric, see [Alibaba Cloud service monitoring metrics](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: Prometheus
parameters.description:
The Prometheus alert configuration.

> Set this parameter only when you create a Prometheus alert rule for Hybrid Cloud Monitoring.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description:
The resource information, such as `[{"instanceId":"i-uf6j91r34rnwawoo****"}]` or `[{"userId":"100931896542****"}]`.

For more information about the supported monitoring dimensions, see [Alibaba Cloud service monitoring metrics](~~163515~~).

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the alert rule.

You can enter a new alert rule ID or use the ID of an existing alert rule in CloudMonitor. For more information about how to query alert rule IDs, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

> If you enter a new alert rule ID, a threshold alert rule is created.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description:
The name of the alert rule.

You can enter a new alert rule name or use the name of an existing alert rule in CloudMonitor. For more information about how to query alert rule names, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

> If you enter a new alert rule name, a threshold alert rule is created.

parameters.name: SendOK
parameters.description: Specifies whether to send a recovery notification.

parameters.name: SilenceTime
parameters.description:
The mute period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400.

> The mute period specifies the interval at which an alert notification is re-sent if the alert does not recover to Normal.

parameters.name: Webhook
parameters.description: The callback URL to which a POST request is sent when an alert is triggered.
